subject: Post-demo: feature-level margin & 1M-token budget checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@healthbridge.com>, Nora Singh <nora@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: feature-level margin & 1M-token budget checklist

Thanks again for taking the demo time this morning — appreciate the candid product questions. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can size a pilot that maps to HealthBridge's goals:

Summary from today's call:
- Primary use: automated triage + short-form summarization inside patient portal messages (~70% of calls).
- Expected traffic: initial pilot 400k–1.2M tokens/month across 3 features (triage, short summary, provider note draft).
- SLA: sub-600ms p95 for interactive flows (triage), background workflows can tolerate higher latency.
- Data controls: VPC + SOC2 evidence required; procurement indicated a 60–90 day procurement window.

Requested from HealthBridge (next steps):
1) Confirm target pilot volume range (best-case / expected / conservative) — we used 1M tokens as a working number this morning.
2) Share the target $/1M-tokens you‘d want to build the feature economics against (ballpark is fine).
3) Any outside-in budget constraints (quarterly budget line for pilots, e.g., $10k–$30k per month) or executive approval thresholds.

Our deliverables by EOD next Tuesday if you confirm the above:
- Excel workbook with feature-level token split + proposed pricing bands (attached: healthbridge_token_estimate.xlsx).
- Two pilot options: performance tier (lower latency, higher $/1M tokens) vs. cost-tier (quantized model, higher latency, ~30% lower cost).
- A CAC-payback sketch that expresses: $/feature (COGS = inference cost per feature), expected conversion uplift, and time-to-payback at 3 adoption rates.

Attachment: healthbridge_token_estimate.xlsx (feature slices, sample token distributions)

Please reply with the volume bucket you want us to model first (400k / 1M / 1.2M). I can run the numbers and return a one-page economics sheet showing: $/feature (inference-only), gross margin at two price points, and CAC payback assumptions.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0146
Redwood Inference

From: Nora Singh <nora@healthbridge.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@healthbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: feature-level margin & 1M-token budget checklist

Thanks Jordan — quick clarifications from us: 
- Pilot volume: start conservative at ~400k tokens/mo, plan to scale to 1M if conversion signals are positive.
- Budget: we have a pilot budget cap of $18k/mo (program budget owner is Liam).
- Target price: ideally we want to see options that land at $700–$1,200 per 1M tokens (this is internal target band; open to tradeoffs between latency and cost).

Two asks for your workbook:
1) Break out cost per feature assuming the token split: triage 45%, summary 35%, provider-draft 20%.
2) Show CAC-payback rows assuming: (a) 0.5% conversion from triage -> paid feature, (b) 1.5% conversion conservative, (c) 3% optimistic.

Also — procurement will ask for SOC2 and a standard BAAs template. Attach any docs you have.

-Nora
Product Lead | HealthBridge
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Singh <nora@healthbridge.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: feature-level margin & 1M-token budget checklist

Perfect — thanks for the clarity, Nora. Attached is the first pass (healthbridge_token_estimate.xlsx) that models the three volume buckets and the token splits you listed. High-level takeaways from the model I ran: 

- Inference-only cost per 1M tokens (baseline, hosted API mid-tier): ~$1,100 / 1M tokens for the high-latency quantized path; ~$1,600 / 1M tokens for the low-latency performance path.
- Using your token split at 1M tokens/month:
  - triage cost: 0.45 * 1M = 450k tokens -> inference-only COGS ~ $495 (quant) / $720 (perf) per month
  - summary cost: 350k tokens -> COGS ~ $385 / $560
  - provider-draft cost: 200k tokens -> COGS ~ $220 / $320
- If you price the feature (triage) at $3.50 per converted user event and assume 0.5% conversion on triage impressions, payback times vary: 
  - At 400k tokens/mo (quant path): projected gross margin on inference-only for triage feature ~65% if list price per converted event aligns to ~$3.50. CAC-payback (paid marketing CAC = $60/customer) breaks even in ~9–12 months at 0.5% conversion.
  - At 1M tokens/mo and 1.5% conversion, payback drops below 4 months for the same assumptions.

Next steps I'm proposing (two-track):
A) External deliverable for HealthBridge — one-pager with: token-cost table ($/1M by path), feature-level COGS table, and a CAC-payback chart for the three conversion scenarios. I will also attach the Redwood SOC2 summary and BAAs skeleton (procurement will need this).
B) Internal ask for pricing frame — Karthik/Marissa, can you review the proposed price bands below and advise which list/discount tiers we should model for an initial quote to Liam?

Proposed list bands to model: 
- Cost-tier (quantized) list: $1,400 / 1M tokens (pilot discountable)
- Performance-tier list: $2,100 / 1M tokens
- Pilot blended price target to hit HealthBridge budget cap ($18k/mo): show a blended effective $/1M that fits under $18k for the 400k bucket (likely requires an initial credit or steeper pilot discount).

Attachments included: healthbridge_token_estimate.xlsx, redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf

I'll wait for the internal price guidance then share the one-pager back to you within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Jordan
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo: feature-level margin & 1M-token budget checklist

Jordan — quick internal notes on pricing cadence and what to present to Liam: 
1) For pilot asks under $20k/mo we should avoid deeper list discounts; instead offer a limited-time pilot credit (60 days) that covers the delta between our pilot blended price and their $18k cap. This keeps list uniform for renewals.
2) Model the economics with two margin targets for the product team: 60% gross margin (target) and 45% floor. Show how each list band maps to those margins after expected infra & support costs (add a 15% ops uplift to inference-only COGS).
3) For CAC-payback outputs — use three marketing CAC scenarios: $40 (inbound-supported), $60 (standard outbound), $120 (enterprise sales-assisted). Provide payback months for the 0.5% / 1.5% / 3% conversion rows so AE can present to CFO.
4) Marissa — can you prepare a one-slide pricing rationale (two price bands, pilot credit approach, renewal escalation language) so we have PR/renewal guardrails?

I'll sync with finance if we need to tabulate a temporary pilot credit line in the quote. Jordan — once Marissa sends the slide, go ahead and send the one-pager + SOC2 summary to HealthBridge.

-Karthik
Head of Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference
